name: Showing changes as they happen
description: Keeps a page up to date with what other people change, by asking one of the app's routes every few seconds while the page is open, without reloading it.
fits: Add it when a page should show other people's changes without being reloaded, such as names added to a sign-up list or votes as they come in. Only for an app with a front end.
edits: On each GET route a page keeps up to date, add Hono's ETag middleware, `import { etag } from "hono/etag";`, as `app.get("/api/signups", etag(), ...)`, so an answer that hasn't changed goes back as a 304 without its body.
In the page, import `poll` from `./live` (from src/client/App.tsx; `../live` from a folder under src/client) and start it in a `useEffect`, as its notes say.
